title: Regular relative degree is invariant under Luenberger output injection
author: Shida Cao, Bin Zhou, Guang-Ren Duan
work: Determination of the output injection of invertible linear systems for guaranteeing a regular relative degree
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: original Theorem 1 of the article (source label thm: (A,B,TyC) and (A+LC,B,TyC), Ty the same, source0.tex lines 849--858): for an invertible system with n-sharp equal to two and any output transformation matrix, the system (A,B,T\_yC) has a regular relative degree if and only if the output-injected system (A+LC,B,T\_yC) has a regular relative degree for every Luenberger gain L. It is delivered with the authors' own complete 31-line proof at source0.tex lines 860--890. H2: the proof is a genuine structural argument on linear systems rather than a qualifying examination computation: the solver must use the delivered characterisation of the n-sharp equals two case to obtain rank conditions on T\_yCB and its extension by T\_yCAB, enumerate the only two admissible relative-degree patterns, and then show that adding the output injection LC preserves both the rank conditions and the pattern, which is what makes the property invariant. Reproducing that invariance argument for multivariable systems is well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying level.

primary.theorem: Theorem 1 (source label thm: (A,B,TyC) and (A+LC,B,TyC), Ty the same)
